name: Aznalcázar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, green at the lower hoist and yellow at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aznalcázar (a castle on green).
history: Municipal flag of Aznalcázar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cap of the crown of the arms
